helpIntro: TCU uses a 4.0 undergraduate scale with plus/minus grades. Enter TCU credit hours and final grades to estimate your semester or cumulative GPA.
helpNote: P/NC courses are excluded from GPA. For a TCU course repeated at TCU, only the last letter grade counts in GPA; graduate grading and transfer-admission GPA use different rules.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12.00 grade points; a 3-credit B+ earns 9.99. Together, 21.99 ÷ 6 = 3.665.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.00 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.67 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.33 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3.00 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.67 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.33 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2.00 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.67 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.33 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.00 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- = 0.67 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.00 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass; earns credit but is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete; excluded until a final grade is assigned; ordinarily converts to F if not removed by the deadline.
gradeExplanations.Q: Course grade removed after approved post-deadline drop; exclude from GPA.

specialTypes.name: TCU undergraduate course
specialTypes.note: Use TCU credit hours and the final undergraduate grade.

specialTypes.name: External transfer course
specialTypes.note: External grades are not part of the enrolled TCU GPA; transfer-admission GPA is a separate calculation.

specialTypes.name: Graduate/professional TCU course or record
specialTypes.note: Graduate grading differs and program standards vary; use the appropriate graduate record policy.

repeatPolicy.note: For a TCU course repeated at TCU, the last letter grade is used in the GPA even if it is lower; all grades remain on the transcript. Notify the Registrar of the repeat.
